description: This source file defines a custom attribute class `RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute` used for placement filtering in Orleans. The attribute specifies that a silo must match certain metadata key-value pairs for placement consideration.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to indicate that a placement filter requires silos to have specific metadata key-value pairs matching the local silo.

parameters.name: metadataKeys
parameters.description: Array of metadata keys that must match

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute with metadata keys and optional order, setting the placement filter strategy.
